documentation_caveats: The OpenAPI enum for response_format.type lists only text and json_object, while the same schema defines a json_schema object with strict. The 22.10 series sent type=json_schema, strict=true to Qwen/Qwen3-Coder-Next and openai/gpt-oss-120b and got 23 of 23 HTTP 200 responses that parsed as typed JSON. For Qwen/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B this is unverified; the transport phase measures it.

The models page marks Structure Output and Function Calling per model but does not say whether output is grammar-constrained or best effort. The runner never trusts the model output to match the schema.
No rate limits or request timeouts are documented on the pages above. The runner sends one request at a time per model and stops on HTTP 429 streaks.

Cloud.ru pages do not state model licenses. open_weights below comes from the vendors: gpt-oss-120b is published by OpenAI under Apache 2.0; Qwen3-Coder-Next and Qwen3.6-35B-A3B are published by Qwen on Hugging Face (Apache 2.0 for Qwen3.6-35B-A3B per secondary sources such as https://www.noze.it/en/insights/qwen-3-6/). The license files were not re-read in this session.
Prices may change without notice per the tariff document. Estimates use the prices below; billing access is not available, so actual billed cost stays NOT_MEASURED.
